name: casino-lobby
description: Casino lobby: React SPA + NestJS mock API

scripts.start: npm run build && npm run serve
scripts.build: npm run build -w @lobby/web && npm run build -w @lobby/api
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @lobby/api" "npm run dev -w @lobby/web"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
